newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine beet harvest nearly over, 21.8 mln T so far.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine beet harvest nearly over, 21.8 mln T so far.

text.p: Ukraine's nearly-completed sugar beet harvest is below official targets, with 21.81 million tonnes harvested so far, down from 30.65 million tonnes at this time last year, a top Agriculture Ministry official said on Tuesday.
Ukraine has forecast a sugar beet crop of 26 million tonnes this year.
"We need only a few more days of good weather to complete this year's beet harvest," said Valentyn Tymoshenko, deputy head of the ministry's crop department.
He said over one million hectares had been harvested, compared to 1.37 million hectares at this time in 1995.
This year's harvest started about two weeks later than usual to allow beets to mature.
According to ministry data, beet yields were down to 19.7 tonnes per hectare from last year's 22.3 tonnes.

Olexsander Bohatarenyk, deputy head of the state sugar concern Ukrsukor, said Ukraine refined sugar output had reached 1.3 million tonnes so far, compared to 1.9 million tonnes at this point last year.
Ukraine expects to refine 2.8 million tonnes of white sugar this year compared to 3.49 million tonnes last year.
